archive_contents.role: Complete line-delimited Unicode Tamil word lexicon

image_geometry_profile.color_mode: RGB (handwritten word crops on off-white/ruled paper backgrounds)

recommended_standardized_model_input_res.preprocessing: Grayscale conversion, aspect-ratio-preserving width resize, right-side padding, [0.0, 1.0] float32 normalization

architecture_suitability.justification: Images are horizontal word crops with variable lengths and heights around 240-300px. Character labels are pure UTF-8 sequence strings without horizontal bounding boxes. The 72 unique character tokens fit seamlessly into CTC loss with index 0 reserved for the blank token.
architecture_suitability.full_page_considerations: Dataset contains isolated word crops, not full pages or full multi-line paragraphs. Building a complete end-to-end full-page OCR system requires a document segmentation stage (text-line binarization, projection profile line-slicing, and connected-component word segmentation) feeding into this word-level CRNN recognizer.
